notes.title: Ultimate: Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Heyho everybody!
We hope you enjoy smashing those pesky zombies!

It's once again that time of the year! The autumn sale is in full swing and comes with its annual celebration of video games: The Steam Awards.

And that's where you come in.
We're proud of the work we put into  Zombie Rollerz and obviously feel that it is the best game ever developed - and if you only think the slightest bit alike, nominating us only makes perfect sense, right? 

These are the awards for which we feel most eligible:

[list]
[*] Best Game You Suck At
[*] Best Soundtrack
[*] Game of the Year
[*] Innovative Gameplay
[*] Outstanding Visual Style
[/list]


If you prefer to nominate us for other awards, that's great as well!
Thank you so much for your support and your help with nominating us for the Steam Awards!

Team Zing Games

notes.title: Patch v0.3.1a
notes.content:
In this patch, we fixed some bugs and update some gameplay mechanics.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add some new patterns to the level.
[*]Rework the extra mechanic of BallModifier MirrorBall.
[*]Rework the active use mechanic of PassiveSkill Fury.
[*]Optimize the generation of levels and patterns.
[*]Rewrite the formula for hero max hp.
[*]Adjust Hero Alien init attributes.
[*]Increase the min damage from the pinball drops between flippers.
[*]Decrease the base damage of the Alien Badge.
[*]Reduce hp requirement for the active use of Passive Skill Living Bomb.
[*]Tweak some zombie attributes.
[/list].
[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Work around the bug that device with touch support can not control with keyboard and mouse.
[*]Remove the debug function of loading animation.
[/list]
[h1]Graphic[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add vfx for the spawning of zombie heads.
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add a tooltip to backpack item ui in keyboard mode.
[/list]
